column2: Push Arequipan Border

The Arequipan viceroyalty has long threatened the heartlands of Beornia while shielding themselves from any incursion into Santiago. It is time we push our claims to the borderlands of Arequipa and create a shield for ourselves.

The Provencals have largely been oppressed and lived under the foot of the Plantagenent monarchy. Many Protestants and nationalist Provencals seek autonomy under Burgundy rather than a Catholic, Anglois dominated monarchy.

Demand The End of the Spanish Protectorship

The Spanish Protectorship, decided after the peace of San Salvador, has governed the unstable peace of 1820. Under the terms of the reluctant peace treaty, Spain would hold a protectorship of the former empire for 20 years, with all nations bound by the treaty being released and free to join Colombia of their own decision upon expiration. With the protectorship expiring, we must now urge the Spanish to follow through with the terms and end the protectorship. If they refuse, all of Gran Colombia will fall behind us to ensure our freedom.
Violate Spanish Protectorship

The false peace of San Salvador has allowed the insidious Spanish to hold onto their empire without any real power to hold it. The peace treaty has not expired, but the Spanish are weak and distracted right now. We must ignore the treaty and strike the Spanish while it is advantageous, even if we do not have all of Gran Colombia stand with us.
End Gran Colombian Dream
The Gran Colombians have been crushed, and Mexico is now fully under our control. It is time we wipe away any memory of that failed state and restore our empire.

With the terms of the treaty demanding an end of our empire upon the expiration of our protectorship, we must launch an invasion of Gran Colombia to quell any notions that we will abandon our empire.

Institute March Laws

The April Laws, also called March Laws, are a collection of laws proposed by Lajos Kossuth with the aim of modernizing the Kingdom of Hungary into a parliamentary democracy, nation state. The April laws would utterly erase all privileges of the Hungarian nobility. Inspired by the the revolutionary cycles of 1830, the new suffrage law would transform the old feudal estates based parliament into a democratic representative parliament. The imperative program includes Hungarian control of its popular national guard, national budget and Hungarian foreign policy, as well as the removal of serfdom.
Institute Modernized Land Reforms

The estates of Hungary have long been feudal and under the heavy influence of the nobility. By passing a set of reforms which ease land ownership for peasantry and reduce the influence of the landowners, we can reduce much of this feudal burden and modernize our system.

The Bohemians have denied us the crown of St. Stefen, claiming that it is part of their national history now. This grave insult must not be left unaswered, for this crown has far more worth to our nation symbolically than to any Bohemian as some bauble in a palace. We must sieze the crown by force, and let Prague know Hungary is not to be trifled with.

The Arequipan Viceroyalty broke free of our rule after several revolts of the Incan nobility and the eventual craftiness of the traitor Obregoso. When our backs were turned to the Colombians, the Arequipans declared their own confederation and broke free of our grasp. Now, it is time we restore Arequipa into our empire.

The power grabbing and lust of ambitious men has brought the confederation into civil war, and even after its end, the greed of the Andean thugs sees no end. It is time the Andes sees the resurgence of the real empire which represents the will of the people. FOR TAWATINSUYU!

Although centuries have passed and the situation has changed, many within Qollaw remember the days where our religion was freely practiced. It is time we gain their support and restore their position within Tawatinsuyu.

The Confederation has been racked by civil war and the ambitions of nationalists seeking to carve their own state from the lands of the confederation, whether they be Natives or Andeans. We must reunite the confederation under the control of Arequipa, likes the old days of the viceroyalty.

Erase Incan Identity

Many of the Andean mestizos have used their identity to flip loyalties depending on their ruler. It is time we make the Andeans commit fully to their identity as citizens of the Incan Empire, not Spain, Arequipa, or Colombia.

However, with the Spanish conquest and system of conversion, assimilation, and repression, the Aimara have forgotten their identities as Incans and resigned themselves to subservience to the foreigners. It is time we revive their pride as true citizens of the Incan Empire.

Peace of San Salvador

A fragile peace has been established in San Salvador, but tensions between Spain and the Colombian territories remain unresolved. The coming years will determine whether this agreement holds or collapses into renewed conflict.
Spain Rejects the End of the Protectorship
Spain has refused to relinquish its authority over Gran Colombia. This decision has inflamed revolutionary sentiment and forced the Colombians to decide how they will pursue their independence.
Spain Violates the Peace of San Salvador
Despite the agreement reached in San Salvador, Spain has acted against its terms. The violation has shattered trust and reignited the flames of independence across the Colombian territories.
Second War of Colombian Independence
With tensions reaching their breaking point, Spain and Gran Colombia once again find themselves at war. The fate of the colonies will be decided on the battlefield.
Treaty of Andagoya
Following a decisive Colombian victory, negotiations at Andagoya have reshaped the political landscape. The dream of a united Colombia may finally be within reach.
Colombia Demands Integration
Gran Colombia seeks to unify the former Spanish territories under a single banner. Local rulers must now decide whether to accept integration or resist.
Colombia Demands Integration
With Spanish authority fading, Gran Colombia offers integration as a path to stability and strength. The choice lies between unity and independence.
Evacuation of the Spanish
Spanish forces have withdrawn from much of the region, leaving behind a fractured political landscape. While independence is closer than ever, the struggle for unity continues.
Collapse of Spanish Authority
Spain's grip over its colonies has weakened beyond repair. Former vassals must now choose between aligning with Colombia or forging their own independent path.
Collapse of Authority in the Colonies
The Spanish colonial system is unraveling. One by one, territories slip from Madrid’s control as the empire struggles to maintain its overseas dominion.
Gran Colombia Demands an End to the Protectorship
Gran Colombia has formally demanded the end of Spanish oversight. Spain must now decide whether to maintain control or allow the Colombians to determine their own future.
End of the Spanish Protectorship
Spain has agreed to end its protectorship over Gran Colombia. A new chapter begins as the Colombians take full control of their destiny.
Expiration of the Spanish Protectorship
The period of Spanish oversight has come to an end. Gran Colombia now seeks to define its future without foreign interference.
Reorganization of Colonial Administration
Spain seeks to reassert control by restructuring its colonial administration, creating new vassal states and consolidating influence across the region.
Collapse of Gran Colombia
Internal divisions and external pressures have torn Gran Colombia apart. The dream of a unified state has collapsed into regional fragmentation.
Spanish Military Expeditions Defeated
Spanish efforts to regain control have failed. Colombian forces have secured a decisive victory, forcing Spain to reconsider its position in the region.
Occupation of Loyalist States
Colombian forces have begun occupying territories that remain loyal to Spain. The balance of power continues to shift as more regions fall under Colombian control.
Advance of Spanish Loyalists
Spanish loyalists have launched a counteroffensive, reclaiming territory and restoring their influence in key regions. The conflict remains far from decided.
Loyalist State Restored
Spanish authority has been reestablished in a loyalist region. The empire attempts to rebuild its influence through restored allies.
Restoration of Spanish Authority
Spain has successfully reasserted control over a former territory, bringing it back into its sphere as a loyal vassal.
